data.title: The Ritz Carlton Residences
data.about:
The Ritz-Carlton Residences at Dubai Creekside, developed by MAG Property Development, is a prestigious addition to Dubai’s luxury real estate market. Nestled within the exclusive Keturah Resort in Al Jaddaf, this off-plan community presents a curated selection of eight G+7 residential buildings and twelve G+2+B waterfront mansions. Branded by Ritz-Carlton, the residences offer 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, spacious 3-bedroom penthouses, and opulent 8-bedroom mansions—each fully furnished with internationally renowned designer pieces and high-end brands.

This exceptional waterfront development redefines luxury living with its exclusive amenities, including a wellness hotel, a private marina designed for yachts, and eight boutique retail spaces. Residents will enjoy access to a shared pool, children’s pool, private beach, and leisure areas designed for ultimate relaxation. Additional features such as a cinema, coworking zone, dining outlets, and a state-of-the-art gym create a seamless blend of comfort, wellness, and convenience, all set against the serene backdrop of Dubai Creekside.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Ritz-Carlton Branded Residences - Experience the hallmark of world-class service and timeless elegance in every detail of your home.
  • Prime Creekside Location within Keturah Resort - Enjoy exclusive access to a private marina, wellness hotel, and Dubai’s most serene waterfront views.
  • Fully Furnished with Global Luxury Brands - Move into meticulously curated spaces adorned with high-end designer pieces and premium international furnishings.
  • Comprehensive Lifestyle Amenities - From private beach access to a cinema and coworking zone, every need is thoughtfully anticipated.

location_tile.title: Tranquil Waterfront Living with Unmatched City Connectivity
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Positioned in the heart of Al Jaddaf along the tranquil Dubai Creek, The Ritz-Carlton Residences at Dubai Creekside offers an exceptional blend of privacy and connectivity. Residents enjoy seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), placing them just moments away from Dubai’s key business districts, lifestyle destinations, and the international airport— while nestled within a peaceful, resort-inspired waterfront enclave.

  • 10 Mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 10 Mins – DIFC
  • 15 Mins – DXB Airport
